blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Sunday confirmed that he had accepted the resignation of Information and Communications Technology Secretary Henry Aguda but said Malacañang delayed announcing it while searching for his replacement. “Yes, but we were holding it back until we found the … replacement,” Marcos said during a Kapihan interview in Singapore. The president said Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla disclosed Aguda’s resignation before the Palace could formally announce it. “But the Ombudsman already spilled the beans before we were able to,” he said.
